method.unit: ms per independent stdin CLI process; native output captured
method.cache: uncontrolled OS caches; first observation is NOT cold startup
method.gate: all shared oracle cases must pass before timing a tool
method.scope: serial CLI latency, not hooks, agents or in-process engine
method.threshold: descriptive median/MAD only; no significance or speed target

excluded.cog: local executable not supplied; not installed or measured
excluded.convco: local executable not supplied; not installed or measured

breaking_bang.rationale: Breaking prefix permits omission of footer (rules 11, 13).

body.rationale: Body separated by blank line; free paragraphs (rules 6, 7).

unicode.rationale: Specification does not require English descriptions (rule 5).

capital_subject.rationale: Specification does not require lowercase descriptions (rule 5).

custom_type_default.rationale: Specification permits additional types; clint defaults restrict the type list.

uppercase_type.rationale: Clint policy requires lowercase ASCII types, not a universal specification verdict.

fixup.rationale: Temporary commits are forbidden by clint policy.

merge.rationale: Clint merge exemption; rejection elsewhere is a policy difference.

nul_before_exemption.rationale: Unsupported content is rejected before merge exemptions.

crlf.rationale: CRLF is accepted without modifying original byte offsets.

length_unicode_at.rationale: Title limit counts Unicode scalar values, not UTF-8 bytes.

length_unicode_over.rationale: Seven scalar values exceed configured six.
